app.title: Cohort Coach
app.tagline: Know what your class gets wrong, then fix it.
status.offline_forced: Offline mode is on for the demo
banner.simulated: Simulated data: this class and these children are made up for the demo.
role.later: This screen is built in a later step. For now, use the teacher screens.
judge.title: Judge mode
judge.intro: A five-minute tour. No login. Everything marked simulated is made up.
judge.step1: Load a simulated class of 28 children.
judge.step2: Open Home and read the one next action.
judge.step3: Open Enter check and try the keypad for one child.
judge.step4: Open My class and read the cards. They show how many children, as counts.
judge.step5: Switch the language to Hindi or Tamil.
judge.step6: Turn on offline mode and open My class again.
judge.advanced: Term 2 has started for the simulated class.
judge.later: Pretty versions of these two come with the Practice Class screen.
home.title: Home
home.status.none: You have not entered this term's check yet.
home.action.cards: See what my class gets wrong
home.demo_hint: Want to look around first? Open Judge mode from the menu.
check.title: Enter the check
check.form: Which paper did the children write?
check.order_note: Enter the papers in roll order. Only your phone knows which paper is which child.
check.need_one: Enter at least one child first.
cards.title: What my class gets wrong
cards.none: No results yet. Enter this term's check first.
cards.focus: This is the focus for your class.
cards.small: Fewer than {min} children were checked, so no focus is chosen yet.
cards.untracked: {n} answers also had the whole ones total written in, like 38 + 47 → 715. This is not a focus yet.
cards.anchor: {n} children got the simple subtraction (question 6) wrong, so read the subtraction cards with care.
cards.audio_soon: Listening arrives in a later step.
cards.flagged: Thank you. The team will review this card.
err.PV-HEARD: Writes a number the way it is said
err.SUB-SFL: Takes the smaller digit from the larger
err.SUB-NODEC: Borrows a ten but does not reduce the tens digit
err.desc.PV-HEARD: write a number the way they hear it
err.desc.SUB-SFL: take the smaller digit from the larger
err.desc.SUB-NODEC: borrow a ten but do not reduce the tens digit
practice.title: Practice class
practice.intro: Rehearse with five pretend children before you try it in class. What you say here is not kept on our servers.
practice.placeholder: Say what you would say to the children
practice.slow: The connection is slow, so a simple reply was used.
practice.paused_hint: You can watch a sample rehearsal instead.
practice.sample_note: This is a recorded sample in English, made with pretend lines.
practice.offline: Practice needs a connection. Try again when you have a signal. Everything else still works.
practice.expired: This practice session has ended. Start a new one.
practice.error: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.
practice.private: Only you can see this. It is not a score.
practice.retry: Try again with the same children
practice.share: Share this session to improve the simulator
practice.share_note: Off by default. Your sessions stay on this phone. Sharing opens in a later update; your choice is saved.
practice.over_all: The rehearsal is over: every child with the mistake got it right twice in a row.
practice.over_cap: You reached the turn limit. See your feedback.
practice.saved: The transcript is saved on this phone only.
layers.title: AI layers for this turn
layers.judge_only: Judge view. Not shown to teachers.
aimap.title: AI map
aimap.intro: Every Claude call, what it does, and its five layers.
aimap.offline: This page needs a connection to the server.
audit.title: Audit trail
audit.intro: The last AI calls. Metadata only: never what anyone said.
judge.step7: Open Practice and say something to the children.
judge.step8: Turn on Show AI layers and read one turn.
judge.step9: Open the AI map, then the audit trail.
practice.voice_fallback: Voice is not working right now, so you can type instead.
practice.mic_denied: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in your browser settings, or type instead.
practice.unheard: I could not hear anything. Hold the button and speak again.
practice.voice_stub: Simulated voice: scripted lines and a tone, not real speech recognition.
check.photo: Take a photo of this sheet
check.photo_done: Filled in from the photo. Check every box, fix any mistake, then go to the next child. Marked boxes need a look first.
check.photo_offline: Reading a photo needs a connection. Type the answers instead, or try again with a signal.
check.photo_typing: Could not read this sheet. Type the answers, or take the photo again in better light.
check.photo_bad: That photo could not be used. Take it again, with the whole sheet in view.
check.photo_failed: Something went wrong reading the photo. Type the answers, or try again.
check.photo_replace: This child already has answers. Replace them with the photo?
practice.goal_line: Help children who {error}. Teach as you would in class; the pretend children make the mistakes your own class makes.
practice.lang_changed: You changed the language. This rehearsal is still in {lang}.
review.title: Your rehearsals
review.private: Recorded on this phone only. Nobody else sees them unless you choose to share.
review.empty: No rehearsals recorded yet. Practise once and it will appear here.
review.summary: Rehearsals: {n}. Helped: {a}. No difference: {b}. Did not help: {c}. Not marked: {d}.
review.again: Practise again with the same children
review.delete_confirm: Delete this recording from your phone?
review.delete_all_confirm: Delete every recording from your phone?
impact.title: Did this rehearsal help?
impact.note: Your own view. It stays on this phone and is not a score.
cue.title: Things you could say
cue.tap: Tap a line to use it, then change it to sound like you.
cue.tip1: Speak slowly and clearly, in short sentences.
cue.tip2: Ask, then wait. Let the child finish before you answer.
cue.tip3: Say the child's name first, then ask. Use the words you use in class.
cue.tip4: Praise the trying, not only the right answer.
history.title: What I entered
history.private: Everything you entered is kept on this phone. Photos are read and then dropped: they are not kept anywhere.
history.photo_n: {n} filled in from a photo, the rest typed
history.server_note: Our server holds only class counts (how many children showed each error). It never holds a child's answers, a name or a photo.
obs.title: After you try it in class
obs.q: Were your real children like the pretend ones?
obs.too_easy: The mistake was easier to fix
obs.too_hard: The mistake was harder to fix
obs.saved_sent: Saved on your phone and sent. Thank you.
obs.saved_local: Saved on your phone. It will be sent when you are online.
obs.note: Only your choices are sent, with no name and no class. They help us make the pretend children more like yours.
prog.title: My programme
prog.simulated_example: An example placement from the simulated block, to show how this screen works.
prog.s1.none: Not done yet. Start with the check.
prog.s3.this: You are in a cohort of {n} teachers who share this error. Your track starts now.
prog.s3.next: You are on the waiting list. Your track starts next term.
prog.s3.wait: Not placed yet. Cohorts are formed once enough classes have sent their check. It will show here.
prog.s4.has: Your cohort will have a mentor: a teacher whose class fixed this error.
prog.s4.later: Mentors are chosen after the next check shows whose class fixed the error. If you are invited, it will show here.
prog.s5.none: None published yet. They appear here after a reviewer approves them, each with audio and text.
prog.where_body: Open this screen any time to see where you stand. When the bot is connected you will also get a message there when you are placed or invited.
prog.offline: Could not reach the server, so only the steps from this phone are shown.
home.privacy_body: Nothing is shared until you say so. Read how your data is used and choose.
profile.title: My profile
profile.delete_class_confirm: Delete {name} and everything kept for it on this phone?
profile.classes_note: Each class has its own checks and rehearsals. Deleting a class also asks our server to erase its counts.
profile.persist_unsupported: This browser cannot protect your data from being cleared. Keep a backup.
profile.persist_on: Your data is protected: the browser will not clear it when space runs low.
profile.persist_off: Your data is not protected yet: the browser may clear it when space runs low.
profile.persist_refused: The browser did not allow it. Keep a backup file.
profile.storage_used: This app uses {used} MB of about {quota} MB available.
profile.backup_note: The file holds your checks, including each child's answers, and your rehearsals. Keep it safe. A passphrase locks it; without it the file is readable by anyone who has it.
profile.restored: Restored {classes} classes, {checks} checks and {rehearsals} new rehearsals.
profile.restore_pass: This backup needs its passphrase. Type it above and try again.
profile.restore_bad: That file could not be used as a backup.
profile.price_per_gb: What 1 GB of data costs you (optional)
profile.cost: About {cost} spent on this app's data.
profile.data_note: Only this app's own calls are counted, on this phone. Photos are shrunk before sending to keep this small.
profile.privacy_intro: Choose what you agree to. Everything is off until you turn it on, and you can change your mind at any time.
profile.consent_at: Your choices were saved on {date} (notice version {v}).
profile.consent_none: You have not made your choices yet.
profile.withdrawn: All consents withdrawn. Counts already sent stay on the server until you erase them.
profile.erase_note: Removes every class, check, rehearsal and setting from this phone, including your consent record, and asks our server to erase the class counts (if you are offline, the counts stay on the server: erase again when online). Feedback you sent has no name on it, so it cannot be found to erase. Consent records on the server are kept as proof.
profile.erase_confirm: Erase all your data on this phone? This cannot be undone.
consent.counts_why: How many children show each error, for grouping teachers. Never a child's answer.
consent.practice: Use AI in the Practice Class
consent.practice_why: What you type or say there goes to AI services (Claude for the replies, Sarvam for speech) to answer you. We do not keep it, and each service has its own retention rules.
consent.share: Share my rehearsals to improve the simulator
consent.share_why: Off by default. Without this, rehearsals stay on your phone.
consent.feedback: Send my feedback to the team
consent.feedback_why: App feedback, simulation notes and flags. Anonymous: no name, class or phone number.
feedback.need_consent: Turn on "Send my feedback to the team" in My profile first.
feedback.refused: That could not be sent. Remove phone numbers, emails or other personal details and try again.
feedback.queued: Saved. It will be sent when you are online.
feedback.note: Please do not write names, phone numbers or anything about a particular child.
practice.consent_title: Allow AI for the Practice Class?
practice.consent_body: To answer you, what you type or say is sent to AI services (Claude and Sarvam). It is not kept on our servers. You can turn this off in My profile.
obs.need_consent: Sharing is off, so this stays on your phone. Turn it on in My profile to send it.
notice.title: Privacy notice
notice.intro: This is how Cohort Coach uses your data under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. We collect as little as we can, and most of it never leaves your phone.
notice.answers_why: To find which mistakes your class makes
notice.counts_why: To group teachers by shared mistakes
notice.counts_where: Our server, under a random class id
notice.counts_keep: Until you erase the class or leave
notice.rehearsal_why: So the pretend children can answer
notice.rehearsal_where: Sent to AI services for the reply; the record stays on your phone
notice.voice: Your voice in the Practice Class
notice.voice_why: To turn what you say into text
notice.voice_where: Sent to the speech service, then dropped
notice.feedback_why: To improve the app and the pretend children
notice.feedback_where: Our server, with no name or id
notice.consent_why: To prove what you agreed to
notice.consent_where: Your phone, and our server under a random device id
notice.consent_keep: As long as the programme runs
notice.children_body: We do not collect any child's name, face, voice or roll number, and sheets carry no name. A child's answers stay on your phone. Photos of sheets are read and dropped at once. Because no child is identifiable to us, we hold no children's personal data; the programme's legal team should still confirm this.
notice.processors_body: Anthropic (Claude) and Sarvam AI process what you type or say in the Practice Class, and photos of sheets, only to answer you. Our hosting provider stores class counts and feedback.
notice.r_access_how: My profile > Save a backup, and What I entered.
notice.r_correct_how: Open the check and change any answer.
notice.r_erase_how: My profile > Erase everything, or delete one class.
notice.r_withdraw_how: My profile > Privacy, at any time; withdrawing is as easy as agreeing.
notice.r_grievance_how: Write to the contact below; you can also go to the Data Protection Board of India.
notice.r_nominate: Nominate someone to act for you.
notice.r_nominate_how: Tell the contact below in writing.
notice.contact_body: Grievance contact: to be added by the programme before real teachers use the app (TODO: name, email, phone).
notice.review: This notice is a draft for the programme's legal review.
admin.title: Admin
admin.open: This page is open because no admin key is set on the server. Set ADMIN_KEY before real use.
admin.auth: The admin key is missing or wrong.
coach.title: Coach
coach.intro: A coach (for example from a DIET) sees how many children show each error across the block. Counts only; nothing about one class or teacher.
coach.later: Approving cohorts and reviewing lessons arrive in a later step.
mentor.title: Mentor
mentor.intro: A mentor is a teacher whose class fixed an error. Your way of teaching helps the next cohort. If you are invited, you would:
mentor.step2: Say which materials you use and how
mentor.step3: Say the exact words you use
mentor.step4: Say how long it takes and when
mentor.later: Invitations come after the next check shows whose class fixed the error. Recording is built in a later step.
check.photo_need_notice: Reading a photo sends it to an AI service. Read the privacy notice and choose first (My profile).
onb.welcome: Welcome to Cohort Coach. It helps you teach the mistakes your own class makes, with five pretend children to practise on first.
onb.consent_core: Your privacy: each child's answers stay on your phone. We keep only class counts and anonymous feedback, and nothing is sent until you say yes. Read the full notice in the web app (My profile > Read the privacy notice). Do you agree to this notice?
onb.declined: No problem. Nothing is saved and nothing is sent. You can read the notice and come back any time.
onb.consent_counts: Send your class counts (how many children show each error, never a child's answer) so teachers can be grouped?
onb.consent_practice: Use AI in the Practice Class? What you type or say there goes to AI services to answer you. We do not keep it.
onb.consent_feedback: Send your feedback and notes to the team? They have no name or class on them.
onb.link: You can use the bot and the web app together. Your code is {code} (valid 15 minutes, works once). Send /start {code} to the bot, or enter it in the web app.
t1.status_none: You have not checked a class yet.
t1.menu: What would you like to do?
t1.cards_none: No class result yet. Check a class first.
t1.cards_clear: No tracked mistake showed up in this check.
t1.check_info: Checking by photo arrives in a later step. For now, enter the answers in the web app.
t1.practice: Rehearse with five pretend children before you try it in class. It opens in the web app.
t1.confirm_delete: Delete everything we hold about you, including your class counts? This cannot be undone.
t1.deleted: Everything was deleted. Send /start to begin again.
flow.title: Step by step
flow.error: Could not reach the server. Check your signal and try again.
flow.telegram: Try it in Telegram: send /start judge to the bot.
